note: Audit declarations for the open column ring under the reservoir.

throughPassages.evidence: The reservoir stands on six free round concrete columns round a central shaft and is open underneath on every side: from the Amstelveenseweg the view runs between the columns under the ring beam to the trees behind (panorama TMX7316010203-002126_pano_0000_000156, artifacts/landmark-briefs/watertoren-amstelveenseweg/r03-90.alt.jpg; Commons 'Amsterdam Watertoren Amstelveenseweg.jpg', 2009, and the 1964 Anefo construction photos, CC0). The BAG ring is the reservoir's plan 19 m overhead, so every bearing is a real through view; six axes 30 deg apart cover all of them.
